# Managed Web Hosting

Our private web server is a highly secure solution with capabilities for most business needs. It is managed in-house and offers a highly secure WAF, the latest LEMP architecture, HTTP/3 support, unlimited storage, malware monitoring, and much more.

 

 

 

## Simplified, Reliable Web Hosting for Your Business

Navigating the world of managed web hosting can feel overwhelming, but it doesn’t need to be. Your web hosting is the foundation of your online presence and visibility — you deserve a hosting provider who prioritizes your success.

With our fully managed hosting solutions, your website is in excellent care. Our hosting solutions are designed to be completely **worry-free**, so you can focus on running your business while we take care of all the technical aspects.

## Why Host with Zadro Web?

Every second counts online. We leverage cutting-edge server technologies — so your website can boost conversions and turn more visitors into buyers.

Our dedicated servers are fine-tuned for any PHP-based architecture, such as [WordPress](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/wordpress-development/), [Craft CMS](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/craft-cms-development/), [Laravel](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/laravel-development/), [CodeIgniter](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/codeigniter-development/), Drupal, and more. Featuring advanced capabilities like server-level caching, multi-threading, and private hosting pools for unmatched speed, security, and reliability.

Beyond hosting, we offer comprehensive website management. Our packages include regular plugin updates, daily backups, 24/7 monitoring, and expert consulting to keep your site performing at its peak.

Comparable computing power on Amazon Web Services (or similar) would cost well over $1,500/month (and that's without any maintenance services).

Originally, web hosting was only offered as part of our [technical SEO](https://zadroweb.com/services/technical-seo/) services to help with online visibility. It’s now a primary service offering to help with all your website needs.

*Your website will perform at its best — all day, every day.*

## Web Hosting Features

- **Highly Secure &amp; Private Web Server** – Your site is isolated from “toxic” neighbors that could harm search rankings.
- **Lightening Fast** – We use the latest technologies to ensure your site loads quickly, every time.
- **Hacker Proof** – Daily anti-virus and malware scans to ensure your web visitors have a safe browsing experience.
- **Fully Managed** – Server maintenance is standard, and DNS management and enterprise-level support can be included.
- **Website Protection** – Full backups and quick restoration options keep your site safe.
- **Monitoring** – 24/7 uptime monitoring of your website, hardware, and redundant networks.
- **Compliance** – Industry leading PCI compliance and robust security measures.
- **Unlimited Resources** – No limits on storage and bandwidth (subject to Acceptable Use Policy).
- **Top-tier Security** – A+ SSL/TLS grading using Qualys analysis, with free SSL certificate included.
- **HIPAA-Eligible** – BAA + HIPAA Addendum, scoped environment, enhanced safeguards.

## Technical Specifications

- LEMP architecture, utilizing the HTTP/3 protocol
- 96GB memory (RAM) and 12 processors (CPUs)
- 4-hour incremental file backups for quick restoration
- 6-hour database backups to Amazon Web Services
- Nightly full-site backups to Microsoft Azure
- Advanced ModSec security and Web Application Firewall (WAF)
- Enterprise-grade IDS and IPS protection
- Malware and anti-virus scanning, at the gateway and bit-level
- DKIM signing on all outgoing email for better deliverability/security
- Blocking of all TOR proxy IPs
- Blocking of all Spamhaus IPs
- Blocking of all GreenSnow IPs
- Blocking of all DShield IPs
- Blocking of all Proofpoint/Emerging Threats IPs

# Craft CMS Development

Midsized and larger projects are an ideal fit for Craft CMS. Its flexibility, performance, and strong security make it our preferred platform for serious custom builds. If you are evaluating options, we can help you decide whether Craft is the right move for your business.

 

 

 

## Enterprise-Grade, Built for Growth

We have been designing and building custom websites for years, and Craft CMS is our primary choice for modern web development. With its flexible content architecture, Craft lets us build anything from simple marketing sites to Craft Commerce e-commerce stores and complex enterprise platforms.

Every Craft CMS site we build is engineered with precision. We use custom fields, clean content modeling, and best-practice [technical SEO](https://zadroweb.com/services/technical-seo/) on every project. Your site loads fast, looks sharp, and is set up to perform in search from day one.

Most platforms are rigid and make assumptions about how your website should work. Craft starts as a blank slate, so we can design and develop a site around your specific goals without unnecessary constraints or bloated code.

**Why Craft CMS?**

- **100% customizable** for truly bespoke user experiences.
- Consistently praised for its intuitive, easy-to-use control panel.
- A rich plugin ecosystem with over **1,000** add-ons to extend functionality as you grow.
- Powerful login system that support **strong security practices**.

Craft CMS also gives your team real control over content. The control panel makes it simple to edit pages, publish new content, and manage complex layouts without needing a developer for every change.

We can also handle ongoing [website maintenance](https://zadroweb.com/services/website-support/) and [managed hosting](https://zadroweb.com/services/cloud-solutions/managed-web-hosting/) so your Craft CMS site stays fast, secure, and up to date.

Not sure if Craft is the right fit for your project? Use the form on this page to share a few details, and we will help you evaluate the best path forward.

 

 

### Let's discuss your project

You can expect a quick response!

 

 

 

 

 

  ## Craft CMS Benefits

Ready to build an enterprise-ready website? Craft CMS, with its powerful custom fields and intuitive, user-friendly interface, ensures your site performs at the highest level, empowering your team to focus on what matters most.

 

 

 

 ### Customization

Craft CMS makes no assumptions about your website's structure, allowing unmatched custom solutions. Whether you require simple content pages or complex enterprise-level systems, Craft allows for extensive flexibility, ensuring your site functions exactly as you envision.

 

 

 

 ### Robust Custom Fields

Craft CMS provides advanced, powerful features for managing custom fields. This enables complete control over how content is stored, displayed, and managed, ensuring your website can grow and evolve without limitations.

 

 

 

 ### Enjoyable Editing

Craft CMS is known for its clean, intuitive admin interface, which makes content management a breeze. Editors and content creators will enjoy a seamless and straightforward experience with powerful tools that won’t overwhelm you or your team.

  ## Our Process

Our process with Craft CMS is built for businesses that need flexibility, performance, and control, from small teams to enterprise organizations. We start by understanding your goals, content needs, and internal workflows, then design a Craft implementation that supports how you actually operate.  
  
From content modeling and custom fields to performance tuning and editing workflows, every step is focused on building a high-performance Craft CMS site that is easy to manage and ready to scale. With Craft, you get a custom website that looks sharp, loads fast, and stays adaptable as your business evolves.  
  
Let’s turn your ideas into a Craft CMS site that works for you long term.

 [Have Questions?](https://zadroweb.com/contact/) 

###   1 Exploration  

 

 This step lays the foundation for a successful Craft build. We run a collaborative discovery session to understand your business, content, audiences, and existing systems. From competitor review to basic technical analysis, we gather the insights needed to plan a focused Craft CMS solution. 

 

 

 

###   2 Strategy  

 

 Together, we define what success looks like. We outline goals, KPIs, and the site structure, then map content types, fields, and user journeys. This strategy phase shapes the Craft content model and ensures the CMS is designed around your real-world editing and publishing needs. 

 

 

 

###   3 Design  

 

 Your website starts to take shape visually. We begin with a homepage concept, refine it based on your feedback, then expand to key interior layouts. Every design decision supports usability, brand consistency, and the content model defined for Craft, so what you see is what we can implement cleanly. 

 

 

 

###   4 Development  

 

 Once design is approved, we build your site on Craft CMS in a secure staging environment. We implement custom fields, templates, and modules, along with performance-minded coding and best-practice technical SEO. The result is a fast, stable site that editors can manage without friction. 

 

 

 

###   5 Launch!  

 

 We test the site across devices and browsers, validate content flows, and confirm it meets modern standards. After your final review, we launch to production on tuned hosting, then monitor behavior and make adjustments where needed so your Craft CMS site performs from day one.

# WordPress Development

Powering over 40% of the web, WordPress is the clear choice for businesses looking for flexibility, scalability, and control. Since 2009, we’ve been crafting custom WordPress themes that are not only built for performance but tailored to meet your unique goals.  
  
Ready to get your project off the ground fast? Our expert team delivers rapid web development without compromising on quality or your budget.

 

 

 

## Scalability for Any Website

We have been designing and building websites for quite a while, and WordPress is the CMS (content management system) that fits most entry-level needs. It has an unlimited array of plugins that can turn a simple website into a shopping cart platform, a directory, an integrated store locator, or almost anything else you can think of.

Every website we build is crafted on a **custom WordPress theme** tailored specifically for you, with best-practice [technical SEO](https://zadroweb.com/services/technical-seo/) *baked* into every build. This ensures your site is not only fast and beautiful but also optimized from the ground up to rank higher in search engines.

Why don't we use pre-built WordPress themes? Most themes are bloated with unnecessary code that slows your site down. Instead, we combine lightning-fast HTML frameworks with a custom theme to ensure your website is unique and highly optimized for speed.

### Why WordPress?

- WordPress is built with SEO in mind, and a few key plugins skyrocket the results.
- **74.6** Million Sites Use WordPress, and growing.
- Out of all self-hosted websites across the web, **43%** are on WordPress!
- There are more than **64,600** WordPress plugins for practically any website need.

Best of all, WordPress puts ***you*** in control, allowing you to easily make updates with its user-friendly interface.

We also offer ongoing [website maintenance](https://zadroweb.com/services/website-support/) to keep your WordPress site running smoothly and up-to-date.

Not sure if WordPress is the right solution for you? Fill out the form on this page, and we’ll be happy to discuss your specific needs!

 

 

### Let's discuss your project

You can expect a quick response!

 

 

 

 

 

  ## WordPress Benefits

Ready to take control of your website? WordPress offers unmatched flexibility, SEO optimization, and an easy-to-use interface. With our custom builds, your site will be fast, scalable, and tailored to your business.

 

 

 

 ### Flexibility

WordPress can be tailored to fit any business need -- whether you’re building a blog, an online store, or a full-featured corporate site. With thousands of plugins and themes available, it offers endless possibilities for customization, ensuring your website can grow and adapt as your business evolves.

 

 

 

 ### Built-In SEO

WordPress is designed with SEO best practices in mind, making it easier for your website to rank higher in search engines right out of the box. With the right plugins and a well-structured theme, your site can easily optimize for key search terms, giving you a leg up on the competition.

 

 

 

 ### User-Friendly

WordPress offers an intuitive, user-friendly interface, allowing you to manage your content with ease -- even without technical expertise. From updating pages to adding new blog posts or products, WordPress puts you in control without needing constant developer support.

  ## Our Process

Our WordPress process is designed for businesses that want a fast, flexible website without unnecessary complexity. We start by understanding your goals, content, and marketing plans, then build a lean WordPress solution that avoids plugin bloat while keeping the site easy to manage.  
  
From theme architecture and custom blocks to performance and security hardening, every step focuses on creating a WordPress site that loads quickly, ranks well, and is simple for your team to update. With WordPress, you get a familiar CMS with a professional, long-term foundation.  
  
Let’s turn WordPress into a stable marketing and lead-generation platform for your business.

 [Have Questions?](https://zadroweb.com/contact/) 

###   1 Exploration  

 

 We begin with a discovery session to understand your business, audience, and content needs. If you have an existing WordPress site, we audit themes, plugins, speed, and security to identify what should be kept, cleaned up, or replaced. 

 

 

 

###   2 Strategy  

 

 Together, we define the site structure, key pages, and content plan, along with goals and KPIs. This includes deciding when to use custom themes, page builders, or block-based layouts, and planning a minimal, reliable plugin stack that supports your needs without slowing the site down. 

 

 

 

###   3 Design  

 

 We design a conversion-focused homepage and extend that look to important interior templates such as services, blog, and landing pages. The designs emphasize clarity, mobile responsiveness, and clean content presentation that works well with WordPress editing tools. 

 

 

 

###   4 Development  

 

 We develop your WordPress site on a staging environment, implementing a custom theme or child theme, configuring plugins, and hardening security. Performance is prioritized from the start with sane caching, image optimization, and clean code to keep page load times low. 

 

 

 

###   5 Launch!  

 

 We test the site across devices, browsers, and key user flows, then run through an SEO and performance checklist. After your final approval, we launch on the hosting of your choice, set up backups and basic monitoring, and hand over a manageable WordPress environment your team can confidently update.

The billing rate for "no contract" services is $195/hour and $350/hour for emergency services.

 

 

 

 ### Speed Fix

# Cloud Solutions

In the last 20 years or so, there have been many technological advancements in the cloud computing industry, offering unique advantages to businesses of all sizes.

Being a web services company, these benefits are wide-ranging. Engaging the cloud can be as simple as making sure your website has a backup in the cloud and can go all the way to full compute resources in the cloud with auto-scaling and redundancy.

Whichever cloud solution you're looking for, we can build it for you or make recommendations to best suit your cloud services needs.

 [Request a Quote](https://zadroweb.com/contact/) 

 ![Cloud solutions](https://static.zadroweb.com/cloud-solutions.png) 

 

  

 

 

  ## Cloud Solutions Benefits

As more companies have needs for software and hardware flexibility, cloud adoption will continue its exponential growth trajectory. Cloud systems provide advanced technologies and can be scaled up or down depending on your operational needs.

 

 

 

 ### Worry-Free

Data loss is a major concern for all organizations, along with data security. Cloud solutions guarantee that sensitive data is securely stored, along with making sure your critical website data is always available.

 

 

 

 ### Scalability

Cloud-based solutions are ideal for businesses with dynamic bandwidth needs. When your business demands grow, increasing cloud capacity is a breeze and doesn't require adding onsite physical hardware.

 

 

 

 ### Collaboration

Cloud environments enable better collaboration across teams and can be built for specific purposes like staging, QA, demo, backups, and of course, production websites.

 

 

 

 

 

 ## Cloud Solutions Services

Cloud solutions can transform your organization’s success by helping your company to become more agile, flexible, and adaptable. From building custom VPS solutions or using our highly-tuned web hosting, let's discuss your cloud needs.

 

 

 

 ### Web Hosting

Our internal private web server is a highly secure solution with capabilities for most business needs. It is managed in-house and offers a highly secure WAF, the latest LEMP architecture, HTTP/3 support, unlimited storage, malware monitoring, and much more.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/cloud-solutions/managed-web-hosting/ "Web Hosting") 

 

 

 ### Amazon Web Services

AWS is the clear leader in cloud infrastructure. We offload many tasks into AWS for our clients. So whether your requirements are building a VPC, auto-scaling your EC2 instances, or simply managing an S3 bucket, we can build a tailored cloud configuration.

 

 

 

 ### Microsoft Azure

When AWS doesn't fit your needs due to security integration requirements or licensing agreements, Azure is a great solution for many companies. With the Microsoft cloud, hybrid integrations for both on-premise and cloud become seamless.

# Technical SEO

---
# Technical SEO

Is your website optimized in the best possible way to increase organic visitors and provide a seamless user experience? How does your optimization strategy increase your Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)?

Search engine optimization is often shrouded in mystery by many agencies. And while there are many technical aspects, the truth is SEO should be highly transparent.

Our methodology will *not* lock you into long-term contracts. We treat SEO differently than most agencies by "chunking" SEO into well-organized standalone components.

 [Request a Quote](https://zadroweb.com/contact/) 

 ![Technical seo](https://static.zadroweb.com/technical-seo.png) 

 

  

 

 

  ## Technical SEO Benefits

There are many reasons to invest in SEO, such as increasing brand awareness, reaching more customers, and earning more revenue. With our process, breaking down the technical aspects brings your website to online success.

 

 

 

 ### Performance

Without a doubt, a high-quality user experience (UX) is crucial. Search engines reward websites that keep site speed, lean code, responsiveness, and many other performance factors high on the list, typically with increased rankings.

 

 

 

 ### Credibility

There's a reason why upwards of 75% of all searches never go beyond the first page of results. A highly optimized site provides better chances for increasing rankings, and ultimately, more conversions.

 

 

 

 ### Indexation

Once your website content has been crawled, it’s up to search engines on whether to index that content. The more content you have indexed through proper optimization, the more opportunities you have for increasing ROI.

 

 

 

 

 

 ## Technical SEO Services

With bite-sized SEO milestones and deliverables, you're never locked. Each service listed here can be a one-off project or be combined into a custom solution depending on your objectives.

 

 

 

 ### SEO Audit

A search engine optimization audit is typically the first step of any SEO project, and we will provide all you need to increase your website's searchability. The custom-tailored audit will be provided in an easy-to-read spreadsheet format along with summaries of each of the 100+ checklist items. These items include deep audits and recommendations on performance, link issues, structured markup, content issues, and much more.

 

 

 

 ### Keyword Research

Without keyword research, you're running blindly towards your search engine optimization goals. This is an extensive process and must be done if you want your website to be prominent in the SERPs. You will receive a highly actionable spreadsheet with search volume, difficulty, and our recommendations. This process and the deliverables can also include copy for your meta titles and descriptions.

 

 

 

 ### Foundational SEO

This unique SEO service that we provide is like non-other in the industry and is oftentimes overlooked. Like building a house, it's critical to have a strong foundation for your website. In this process, we will manually add your website to the most prominent citation directories, optimize your social media profiles, and check your analytics and tracking systems to make sure they are set up for success.

 

 

 

 ### Server Log Analysis

Analyzing the access and error logs created by web servers provides valuable information. These log files contain information about the visitor requesting the page, the time they made the request, the URL of the requested page, and other technical details such as errors encountered during their visit. By evaluating these server files, we can uncover issues that are preventing better search engine placement.

 

 

 

 ### Website Migration

Moving your website from one domain to another or from one type of CMS platform to another is critical to get right the first time. Botched website migrations can plummet your search rankings. We provide a complete inventory of your website and create a staging environment before launching your new website's destination. Link preservation, 301 redirects, image equity, metadata, and more -- we cover it all for a smooth transition.

 

 

 

 ### SEO Consulting

Do you manage a team of developers? Or, maybe your website is stuck and not getting the best traction in the search engines from your current SEO efforts. In either case, a professional consultation could be highly beneficial. Consulting starts with a discovery call to learn more about your sticking points, then a full analysis of your existing infrastructure. Blocks of hours can be purchased to be used across any SEO service.

# Web Development

Custom web development is our core service. Whether you need a streamlined marketing site or a highly bespoke web application, we design and build on modern CMS platforms and [PHP frameworks](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/php-development/) tailored to your goals.

By using open-source technologies, we deliver websites and applications that are fast, secure, and ready to grow with your business. From theme and template work to fully custom builds and integrations, every project is engineered for performance and long-term maintainability.

With strong roots in infrastructure and [technical SEO](https://zadroweb.com/services/technical-seo/), we go beyond typical agencies. Your site is coded for speed, search visibility, and security from day one, so you get a web presence that actually supports your business, not just looks good.

 [Request a Quote](https://zadroweb.com/contact/) 

 ![Web development](https://static.zadroweb.com/web-development.png) 

 

  

 

 

  ## Web Development Benefits

Working with a full-stack web development company has many advantages. At Zadro Web, we take your conceptual designs and use the latest technologies to code a final product that exceeds your expectations.

 

 

 

 ### Security

Security is a top priority for all the web projects we deliver. We use secure coding practices, sensible configurations, and ongoing updates so your site and data stay protected as your traffic and business grow.

 

 

 

 ### SEO

Search engine optimization is baked into every build. We follow modern technical SEO best practices and code to clean, standards-based HTML so search engines and users can trust and understand your site.

 

 

 

 ### Speed

We prioritize performance from the start and can deliver rapid development on most projects, depending on complexity. You get efficient timelines, clear communication, and a site that feels fast for your users.

 

 

 

 

 

 ## Web Development Services

Full-stack web development services to make sure your website has the best chances of being found by your target audience (and search engines).

 

 

 

 ### Craft CMS

Midsized and larger projects are an excellent fit for Craft CMS. Its flexibility, performance, and strong security make Craft our go-to solution for most custom builds. If you are unfamiliar with Craft or want to see whether it fits your business, we can walk you through the options.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/craft-cms-development/ "Craft CMS") 

 

 

 ### WordPress

Powering over 40% of the web, WordPress is the primary CMS of choice for many businesses. We have been building custom WordPress themes since 2009 and can help you launch quickly with a budget-friendly solution. If rapid web development and cost are key factors, this is likely the best route.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/wordpress-development/ "WordPress") 

 

 

 ### Laravel

A modern PHP framework with a rich ecosystem, Laravel is ideal for building robust, scalable web applications and APIs. If your project needs clean architecture, strong security, and room to grow, Laravel is often the smartest long-term investment.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/laravel-development/ "Laravel") 

 

 

 ### CodeIgniter

Light, fast, and efficient, CodeIgniter is perfect for smaller custom apps and existing systems that need reliable ongoing development. If you have a legacy CodeIgniter project or want lean performance without unnecessary bloat, we can help you get the most out of it.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/codeigniter-development/ "CodeIgniter") 

 

 

 ### CakePHP

CakePHP focuses on rapid development and convention over configuration, which helps deliver custom applications quickly without sacrificing quality. If you want solid structure, quick turnaround, and a framework that keeps maintenance costs in check, CakePHP is a strong option.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/cakephp-development/ "CakePHP") 

 

 

 ### White-Label Services

Are you a creative agency or a freelance designer? We partner with top web designers and agencies to turn UX and UI concepts into production-ready websites. With our white-label development services, we work behind the scenes so you can deliver more value under your own brand.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/white-label-development/ "White-Label") 

 

 

 ### Yii

Yii is a strong choice for many custom web development needs, especially where simplicity and performance matter. With Yii2, you get rapid development without sacrificing security or flexibility. If you want a fast, efficient build that remains easy to maintain, Yii is worth considering.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/yii-development/ "Yii") 

 

 

 ### Symfony

For custom enterprise applications, Symfony is a powerful and reliable framework. It is designed to handle large, complex projects and provides a stable foundation that can grow with your business. If you need a long-term solution, Symfony should be on the shortlist.

 [Learn More](https://zadroweb.com/services/web-development/symfony-development/ "Symfony") 

 

 

 ### PHP Frameworks

We support many other PHP frameworks, such as Drupal, Joomla, Statamic, and more. If your website runs on a custom PHP solution and needs upgrades, security improvements, or ongoing maintenance, we can usually step in and support your existing stack.
